*🏦 Cosmos Central Bank - Loan Facility*

Available commands:
• *.loan apply <amount> [collateral_name]* - Apply for a loan with AI assessment
• *.loan pay [amount]* - Repay your active loan (default: full amount)
• *.loan status* - View your active loan and repayment deadline
• *.loan info* - View your credit score, reputation, and borrowing limits
